description:
Title: Find a Job

You have to regularly report, to which companies you wrote job applications.
Based on your job applications, new potential job offers are sent to you.
Companies have to confirm that they received job applications and rate the application.
A job interview can be negotiated.
When a company wants you to work for them, you enter the probation phase.
After probation phase, you can rate the company and the company can rate you.
Reviews for a company can only be seen (by job applicants) after 1 year.
If a job becomes permanent, the process ends, unless you rated the company C or less, then you continue to receive job offers, but no longer have to report.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/find-a-job" id="Definitions_FindAJob">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ApplicationReceipt" name="Application receipt confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ApplicationRating" name="Application rating"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_JobOffer" name="Job offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CompanyRating" name="Company rating of applicant"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FindAJob">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Job applicant" processRef="Process_FindAJob"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Companies" name="Companies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Receipt" name="Application receipt confirmation" sourceRef="Participant_Companies" targetRef="Event_ReceiptConfirmation" messageRef="Message_ApplicationReceipt"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ApplicationRating" name="Application rating" sourceRef="Participant_Companies" targetRef="Event_ApplicationRating" messageRef="Message_ApplicationRating"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_JobOffer" name="Job offer" sourceRef="Participant_Companies" targetRef="Event_JobOffer" messageRef="Message_JobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InterviewToCompany" name="Interview negotiation" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateInterview" targetRef="Participant_Companies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InterviewFromCompany" name="Interview negotiation" sourceRef="Participant_Companies" targetRef="Task_NegotiateInterview"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompanyRating" name="Company rating of applicant" sourceRef="Participant_Companies" targetRef="Event_CompanyRatesApplicant" messageRef="Message_CompanyRating"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_FindAJob" name="Find a Job" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_FindAJob">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Applicant" name="Job applicant">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_FindAJob</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReportApplications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ApplicationUpdatesSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_ReceiptConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_ApplicationRating</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ApplicationUpdatesJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OffersMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_JobOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InterviewDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NegotiateInterview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InterviewMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CompanyDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Probation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RatingsSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RateCompany</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReviewVisibilitySplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_OneYear</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ReviewVisible</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_CompanyRatesApplicant</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RatingsJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PermanentDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RatingThreshold</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_JobPermanent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_FindAJob" name="Start job search"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReportApplications" name="Regularly report companies applied to"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ApplicationUpdatesSplit" name="Receive application updates"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiptConfirmation" name="Application receipt confirmed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Receipt" messageRef="Message_ApplicationReceipt"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ApplicationRating" name="Application rated by company">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ApplicationRating" messageRef="Message_ApplicationRating"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ApplicationUpdatesJoin" name="Application updates received"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OffersMerge" name="Continue to job offers"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_JobOffer" name="Receive potential job offer">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_JobOffer" messageRef="Message_JobOffer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewDecision" name="Negotiate an interview?">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InterviewYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InterviewNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_NegotiateInterview" name="Negotiate job interview"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewMerge" name="Continue after interview decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompanyDecision" name="Company wants applicant to work for it?">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CompanyYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CompanyNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Probation" name="Enter probation phase"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RatingsSplit" name="Rate after probation"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RateCompany" name="Rate company"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ReviewVisibilitySplit" name="Separate rating outcome from review visibility"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OneYear" name="Wait one year for company review visibility">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_OneYear">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1Y</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReviewVisible" name="Company review becomes visible to job applicants"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CompanyRatesApplicant" name="Company rates applicant">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CompanyRating" messageRef="Message_CompanyRating"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RatingsJoin" name="Ratings completed"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PermanentDecision" name="Does the job become permanent?">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PermanentYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PermanentNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RatingThreshold" name="Rated company C or less?">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RatingLow</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RatingHigh</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_JobPermanent" name="Job becomes permanent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Report" sourceRef="Start_FindAJob" targetRef="Task_ReportApplications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Report_UpdatesSplit" sourceRef="Task_ReportApplications" targetRef="Gateway_ApplicationUpdatesSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdatesSplit_Receipt" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicationUpdatesSplit" targetRef="Event_ReceiptConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdatesSplit_Rating" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicationUpdatesSplit" targetRef="Event_ApplicationRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receipt_UpdatesJoin" sourceRef="Event_ReceiptConfirmation" targetRef="Gateway_ApplicationUpdatesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApplicationRating_UpdatesJoin" sourceRef="Event_ApplicationRating" targetRef="Gateway_ApplicationUpdatesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdatesJoin_OffersMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicationUpdatesJoin" targetRef="Gateway_OffersMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OffersMerge_Offer" sourceRef="Gateway_OffersMerge" targetRef="Event_JobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Offer_InterviewDecision" sourceRef="Event_JobOffer" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewDecision" targetRef="Task_NegotiateInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${interviewNegotiated}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewDecision" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewTask_Merge" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewMerge_CompanyDecision" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyDecision" targetRef="Task_Probation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${companyWantsApplicant}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyDecision" targetRef="Gateway_OffersMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Probation_RatingsSplit" sourceRef="Task_Probation" targetRef="Gateway_RatingsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingsSplit_RateCompany" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingsSplit" targetRef="Task_RateCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingsSplit_CompanyRates" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingsSplit" targetRef="Event_CompanyRatesApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RateCompany_VisibilitySplit" sourceRef="Task_RateCompany" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewVisibilitySplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VisibilitySplit_OneYear" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewVisibilitySplit" targetRef="Event_OneYear"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OneYear_ReviewVisible" sourceRef="Event_OneYear" targetRef="End_ReviewVisible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VisibilitySplit_RatingsJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewVisibilitySplit" targetRef="Gateway_RatingsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyRates_RatingsJoin" sourceRef="Event_CompanyRatesApplicant" targetRef="Gateway_RatingsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingsJoin_PermanentDecision" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingsJoin" targetRef="Gateway_PermanentDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PermanentYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_PermanentDecision" targetRef="Gateway_RatingThreshold">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${jobBecomesPermanent}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PermanentNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_PermanentDecision" targetRef="Task_ReportApplications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingLow" name="C or less" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingThreshold" targetRef="Gateway_OffersMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${companyRatingCOrLower}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingHigh" name="Above C" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingThreshold" targetRef="End_JobPermanent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewNo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyNo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PermanentNo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingLow"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
